owner.description:
Email address of the idea author. The backend looks up (or creates) the
person record from this email and attributes the feedback to them. This
is NOT a user ID — sending a numeric ID will return 400.

importanceId.description:
Portal importance — numeric ID OR exact name (case-insensitive). When
omitted, the portal's `isDefault: true` importance is used (see
`GET /feedback_portal/{portalId}/importances`).
